title: Task picker
desc: Helps you choose what a focus session is for

variables.name: task_asked
variables.desc: whether you were asked what you're on this session

variables.name: task_done
variables.desc: set as a task's done: what's next is asked

variables.name: said
variables.desc: what you said you're working on

variables.name: groups
variables.desc: the groups with a task to start now

variables.name: g
variables.desc: the group it's in, by its place in groups

variables.name: picked
variables.desc: whether you picked the group (not jev)

variables.name: others
variables.desc: whether another group is offered with the tasks

variables.name: hinted
variables.desc: jev's task, by its place in the group's

watching.desc: a session without a task, not asked yet?

do.name: asked
do.desc: out of a session: asked again the next one

next.desc: a session, no task yet, not asked

values.says: 'Done. What\'s next?' if task_done else 'What are you working on?'

guessing_group.desc: jev's group for it: taken if it's sure, or if there's one

do.name: groups
do.desc: the groups with a task to start now

context.format: What someone says they're working on: {said}

questions.question: Which of their groups of tasks is it part of?
questions.criteria: zip(groups.name, groups.desc) + [['Something new', 'None of these: a todo for the planner']]

when: len(groups) == 1 or guess.conf >= 0.6 and g < len(groups)
next.desc: jev is sure, or there's one

picking_group.desc: which group it's in, jev's picked already

context.format:
“{said}”

Which of your groups is it part of?

guessing_task.desc: jev's task for it, in the group

context.format:
What someone says they're working on: {said}
It's part of “{name}”: {desc}

questions.question: Which of these tasks is it?
questions.criteria: zip(tasks.name, tasks.desc) + [['Something new', 'None of these: a todo for the planner']]

do.name: others
do.desc: another group offered, unless you picked it

picking_task.desc: which task it is, jev's picked already: the task, or another group, or something new

ask_usr.title: Which task?
ask_usr.options: tasks.name + (['Another group'] if others else []) + ['Something new']

do.name: on
do.desc: the task you're on: the one picked

set.name: work.task
set.expr: tasks[answer] if 0 <= answer < len(tasks) else None

when: work.task is not None or answer is None

noting.desc: something new: a todo for the planner (its time isn't counted, until it's a task)

do.name: todo
do.desc: adds a todo of what you said

expr.content: said + (', in “' + groups[g].name + '”' if g is not None and 0 <= g < len(groups) else '')

context.format: Noted for the planner: “{said}”. Its time counts once it's a task.
